summary: Added January and July2022 regional Guinea Current depth scenarios with all14 source anchors supported. All70 earlier scenarios and canonical ownership lists are preserved. These remain qualified model threshold estimates, not whole-current physical thickness, annual ranges or volumes. All numerical work and tests ran sequentially in the cloud.
scientific_review: January15 and July15,2022 regional Guinea Current cases retain all14 original sections. All14 original profiles support primary10cm/s lower contours and paired threshold spans. No original anchor is replaced or dropped.

Fixed90degree eastward component, surface>5cm/s and complete finite native upper200m signed-integral selection were declared before fields. Complete upper200m support may exclude shallow shelf flow. Broad-gate numerical maxima remain proxies; independent named-current axis membership and current-wide representativeness are not established.

Source Alory2021 summer upper50m description is context rather than an imposed cutoff. Guinea Counter Current, Guinea Under Current, equatorial SEC, upstream NECC and detached eddies remain separate target identities and possible contamination limitations. Partial Cape Palmas approach to2E geography and latitude gates are exploratory OSW choices, not digitized axes or physical width bounds.

Frozen v18 source-to-reference and v12 adjacent-only interpolation preserve all original anchors and any ineligible neighbors. Depth varies along assumed connectors between supported source locations. These connector lengths are not independently measured current lengths. Paired model threshold spans are not physical whole-current thickness or volume.

Immutable v14 base, all six previous addenda, all70 earlier supported scenarios, historical unresolved cases, all previous CSV cells and canonical ownership lists are preserved. Inventoryv7 adds two supported regional scenarios for34 currents;77 remain without regional projections. No complete physical whole-current depth profile or physical full-current volume is admitted.

Eleven cloud projection checks verify source values, pointers, scope/frame/gates, selection/censoring and gap retention, adjacent-only interpolation, mutation rejection, pinned piece integrity and preservation of earlier cases. Six canonical baseline checks passed on the same source commit. All calculations and tests ran sequentially in the cloud on one idle CPU; local work was metadata/code, hash verification and exact cloud-byte retention.

Two dated model snapshots do not establish monthly means, annual extremes, seasonal envelopes, uncertainty bounds, matched width-depth section areas or physical current volumes. Runtime/query UI integration and whole-route observational validation remain unfinished.
